treatment.logline: An unnoticed dropped phone turns a passing stranger into a first encounter.

arc.beat: Preoccupied movement becomes an unnoticed loss.
Kasun immediately acts and draws her attention.
Her turn completes their first contact.

treatment.approach: Realistic Sri Lankan drama played as a small accident and a useful response, not a chase. Five essential sources total 22 seconds: combine the stowing setup and isolated fall with a grounded-phone hold, then separate her continuing walk, his retrieval, his projected L3, and their encounter. H-90 requires the accident detail and continuation to be separate. D05 is interpreted as no score or added dialogue, preserving L3 and restrained location sound. Natural rain light remains directional under the stall canopy; performances stay understated.

colour_script.palette: Rain-grey roadside, restrained natural clothing colours and muted vehicle paint.
colour_script.light: Overcast daylight from the open road, with darker shelter beneath the three-wheeler canopy.
colour_script.grade: Natural skin, controlled wet highlights and modest contrast; no romantic glow.

treatment.geography: Three-wheeler is screen left; Anudi travels left to right along the roadside. Kasun follows the same direction. In the final view he remains left and she remains right, turned left. Anudi holds the umbrella in her left hand; her handbag hangs from her left shoulder at her left hip; her right hand attempts the pocket. Kasun retrieves and retains the phone in his right hand.
treatment.key_image: A phone extended across the small gap between two people beneath the rain.
advice: End before the phone changes hands; the following scene owns acceptance.
Keep the phone plain and its screen dark; no invented notifications.
Keep Anudi's gaze along her route during her continuing walk.
Use the fall detail as causal coverage, not a stylized slow-motion event.

sequences.title: Loss, recovery, encounter
sequences.purpose: Make the accident legible and the helpful response immediate.

moments.what: A tight bag-side view establishes the stowing attempt and shows the missed pocket and fall; a separate medium view starts with the phone already on the road as Anudi continues.
moments.feeling: The audience notices what she has missed.
moments.cut_uses: An insert from the road-facing side covers the cause and fall, followed by a side-on medium continuation. Both are necessary to avoid a visibly staged non-reaction.

moments.what: Kasun spots the phone, retrieves it and hurries right after Anudi.
moments.cut_uses: One low medium-wide from the same side of the travel axis keeps his reach and first running steps together.

moments.what: Kasun projects L3 toward Anudi while retaining the recovered phone.
moments.feeling: Urgency that is friendly rather than alarming.
moments.cut_uses: An eye-level medium single gives the complete line its own uninterrupted performance.

moments.what: Anudi stops and turns; Kasun approaches and extends the phone without transferring it.
moments.cut_uses: A steady two-shot keeps her turn before his offer and leaves the physical gap visible.

editor_notes: Five must sources, 22 seconds in all; their overlapping coverage and handles are raw material for an approximately 17-second intended scene, not 22 seconds of required screen time.

3A-1 is the bag-side causal detail: the pocket rim and swing send the phone down. Its final phone-only interval can supply a still image where needed. 3B-1 is the separate continuing-walk source, starting with the phone already grounded; cut the two on movement and match the exact phone position and wet-road orientation.
3C-1 shows the notice, right-handed retrieval and first pursuit steps. Match the grounded phone to the previous setup, and maintain its right-hand hold through 3D-1 and 3E-1.
3D-1 carries the complete L3 performance. 3E-1 is the turn and offer; place the turn before the extension and end before any transfer. Match Anudi's umbrella and handbag on her left side.

Kasun starts at the three-wheeler service opening, a step from the phone, an editorial choice within the unspecified starting placement. Keep his early-business wardrobe simple and maintain both cast continuity references.
D05 is treated as no score or added dialogue, not the removal of scripted L3; use restrained natural rain and road ambience.

Speed ramps, freeze frames, digital punch-ins and split screens are post-only possibilities, not rendered camera moves; these steady sources are available if the editor elects to use them, although none is required for the intended cut.
Avoid mirrors, fast finger work, body contact and a visibly staged non-reaction. The phone never changes hands in this scene.

review.why: A quiet wide view establishes the rain-damp road, the canopy and the route before the locked accident coverage.
